keySentence: Her friends needed heart and courage — already inside them.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Scarecrow was already smart. Tin Man already had love. Lion was already brave. Her friends needed heart and courage already inside them.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The friends finally understood the Wizard's wonderful lesson. Scarecrow had solved every problem on their long journey. Tin Man had cried real tears when his friends were hurt. Lion had fought enemies even when he was terrified inside. Her friends needed heart and courage already inside them all along. Sometimes we already have what we are looking for.
